name: Dynasty Ceramic Public Company Limited
summary: Dynasty Ceramic Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of ceramic floor and wall tiles in Thailand and internationally. The company also offers tile grout, tile adhesives, and corner-trim products. It sells its products under the Jaguar, RCI TILE, RCI PORCELEIN, RCI MOSIAC, Birdy, Butterfly, Chicken, Rhino, Ducky, Swan, and Penguin brands. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
